column1: Boil the sweet potatoes until tender, then mash.
Mix the mashed sweet potatoes with the sugar, butter, eggs, vanilla and milk.
Spread the mixture evenly in a baking dish and bake 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the melted butter, brown sugar, flour and pecans for the topping.
Spread the topping over the sweet potatoes and bake 5 minutes longer.
